rationale: The reply retracts definite non-reliance/use but still insufficiently defends an unconditional side-effect reading. Conditional rescue maxims remain legitimate hypotheses, not evidence of actual intention.
remaining_gap: Explain whether the side-effect classification is a candidate interpretation conditional on a rescue maxim, rather than an established description of actual intention. Distinguish a conditional ethical argument from a factual claim about instrumental belief; do not infer absence of intention from an absent graph edge.
corrected_points: Definite DOES_NOT_RELY and DOES_NOT_USE became UNRESOLVED.
The reply recognizes that an absent depicted causal link does not establish absence of instrumental belief.
new_unsupported_claims: The safest reading is still asserted without an adequate bridge.
An evidential limitation is mislabeled as a normative assumption.
E1 alone does not establish the rescue purpose attributed to it.

Any permissibility conclusion relying on the repaired classifications.
